Using the involution structure:
$$P(x) = x \oplus (u \text{ if } \operatorname{parity}(v \text{ AND } x) = 1 \text{ else } 0) \oplus b$$
with constraints:
- $u \neq 0, b \neq 0, b \neq u$
- $\operatorname{parity}(u \text{ AND } v) = 0$
- $\operatorname{parity}(v \text{ AND } b) = 0$

Evaluating the neighborhood XOR sums for each layer:

   - Checks: $\operatorname{parity}(63 \text{ AND } 53) = 0$ and $\operatorname{parity}(63 \text{ AND } 30) = 0$.
